text: Writing clean code is an important skill for every programmer. Clean code is easy to read and understand, even for someone who did not write it. One key idea is using clear naming conventions for variables and functions, so their purpose is obvious. Another is keeping functions small and focused on a single task. This makes the code simpler to test and change. Clean code is also easier to maintain, because other developers can find and fix problems quickly. In short, writing readable code saves time and reduces mistakes, which benefits the whole team.
